skill_name: Make up a story about a day in the life of someone.
workflow: Sue was a 20-year-old student living on her own for the first time and feeling excited about the possibilities that her newly found independence afforded her. She awoke early that morning and had breakfast, before heading off to her classes. She was an exemplary student, and worked diligently in her classes. After the lectures, she left the university and went to the library, wanting to utilize the time she had between classes to read up on some interesting topics she had encountered in lecture.
